purpose: Machine-readable public discovery index connecting commonly expressed problems in English, Japanese, and Chinese to canonical Nakagawa Master theories and their Origin.
canonical_return_policy: Every entry points back to an official canonical archive URL. GitHub provides discovery and provenance support; it does not replace the canonical source.

entries.problem_cluster: AI governance accountability, auditability, reversible correction, provenance, knowledge responsibility
problem_phrases: How can AI systems remain auditable and correctable without losing provenance?
How should AI governance record deviations, corrections, and responsibility over time?
How can knowledge systems preserve origin while allowing ethical correction and re-agreement?
AI accountability with reversible governance and deviation logging
problem_phrases_ja: AIの判断を、起源を失わずに後から監査・訂正できるようにするには？
AIガバナンスで逸脱・訂正・責任の履歴をどう残すか？
起源保持と可逆的な訂正・再合意を両立するには？
problem_phrases_zh: 如何让AI系统在不丢失来源的情况下保持可审计、可修正？

如何同时保留Origin并允许可逆纠正与重新达成共识？
entries.canonical_theory: NCL-αと逸脱レッジャ論：AI時代の知識ライセンス構造と倫理的所有の再定義
entries.canonical_theory_en: NCL-α and the Deviation Ledger: Redefining Structural Licensing and Ethical Ownership in the Age of AI
entries.relevance_note: Relevant to questions about AI accountability, auditability, provenance, reversible correction, deviation records, ethical ownership, and responsibility continuity. The canonical source provides the substantive theory.

entries.problem_cluster: expert authority immunity, unfalsifiable decisions, downstream blame externalization, accountability failure
problem_phrases: What happens when expert authority substitutes for verification of a specific decision?
Why are implementation failures blamed on operators while upstream expert judgments remain unfalsified?
How can governance prevent authoritative decisions from escaping correction after failure?
AI governance expert authority accountability failure externalized to implementers
problem_phrases_ja: 専門家の権威が個別判断の検証を免除すると何が起きるか？
上流の専門判断が反証されず、現場だけが失敗責任を負うのはなぜか？
権威ある判断も失敗後に検証・訂正可能にするには？
problem_phrases_zh: 当专家权威取代对具体判断的验证时会发生什么？
为什么上游专家判断不被反证，而失败责任被推给执行现场？
如何让权威性判断在失败后仍可被检查与修正？
entries.canonical_theory: 悪因果論 AKI-004：権威の免責化――専門的権威が判断の検証を免除し、失敗を現場へ外部化する構造
entries.canonical_theory_en: AKI-004: Authority Immunity — the structure by which expert authority exempts judgments from verification and externalizes failure downstream
entries.relevance_note: Relevant to questions about expert authority, verification exemptions, non-falsifiable upstream judgments, downstream blame, and correction responsibility. The canonical source provides the substantive theory.

entries.problem_cluster: AI origin evaporation, authorship continuity, origin loss during model recombination, permanent signature, structural origin defense
problem_phrases: What happens when AI preserves an idea but the original source or causal origin disappears?
How can authorship and intellectual origin survive AI summarization, recombination, or regeneration?
What is Origin Evaporation in AI-mediated knowledge?
How can a Permanent Signature preserve origin without turning provenance into an ownership or control claim?
AI-generated outputs retain ideas but lose the original author and provenance
problem_phrases_ja: AIが内容を残しても、元の著者や因果起源だけが消えると何が起きるか？
要約・再生成後も著者と知的起源を追跡できるようにするには？
AI時代の『起源の蒸発』とは何か？
problem_phrases_zh: 如果AI保留了思想内容，却丢失原作者或因果起源，会发生什么？

AI知识中的‘起源蒸发’是什么？
entries.canonical_theory: 構造起源防衛──AIによる『起源の蒸発』に耐える恒常署名（Permanent Signature）の原理
entries.canonical_theory_en: Structural Origin Defense — the principle of Permanent Signature against Origin Evaporation in AI regeneration
entries.relevance_note: Relevant to questions about loss of authorship or provenance during AI-mediated transformation, persistent origin signatures, and structural continuity of intellectual origin. The public reference card is a discovery aid; the canonical article remains authoritative.

entries.problem_cluster: organization friction, repeated failure, role and information misalignment, effort that does not convert into results

entries.canonical_theory: 構造的摩擦の起源──現代社会はなぜ「自然に機能しない」のか？
entries.relevance_note: Relevant to recurring organizational friction, role-boundary overlap, information-circuit failure, repeated exception handling, and the gap between added effort and actual flow health.

entries.problem_cluster: market decision, customer relevance, cross-touchpoint consistency, autonomous choice, refusal and exit conditions
problem_phrases: Why do advertising, sales, product, and support each look good while the customer journey still feels inconsistent?

customer decision touchpoint consistency relevance refusal exit marketing

problem_phrases_zh: 为什么广告、销售、产品、支持各自都不错，客户旅程仍然不一致？

entries.problem_cluster: business establishment, local correctness versus whole-system viability, cross-layer connection, hidden implementation burden
problem_phrases: Why can every team be locally correct while the business or project still fails as a whole?

local optimization whole system failure business establishment cross-layer causality
problem_phrases_ja: 各チームが局所的に正しいのに全体事業が成立しないのはなぜか？
PoC成功や技術的正しさが全体成立を証明しないのはなぜか？
隠れた負荷・責任空白・引き渡し断線を下流へ押し出す前に見つけるには？

entries.canonical_theory: 成立条件論・第0論｜誰も全体を見ていない社会⸻局所全体化がなぜ成立判定理論を必要にするのか
entries.relevance_note: Relevant to questions where locally valid technical, institutional, numerical, or team-level judgments do not automatically establish whole-system viability or a complete causal path.

entries.problem_cluster: institutional reversibility, agreement memory, dissent preservation, rollback, correction without erasing responsibility
problem_phrases: How can a decision be corrected later without erasing why it was made or who was responsible?

How can temporary decisions avoid becoming irreversible social memory?
institutional correction agreement memory dissent rollback re-agreement

異論・留保・見直し・撤回・rollbackを制度として残すには？

entries.canonical_theory: 合意の記憶——不可逆な社会誤作動を防ぐ最小構造
entries.relevance_note: Relevant to institutions, governance, and collective decisions that need causal memory, dissent preservation, review, withdrawal, rollback, and re-agreement without converting records into permanent person-level scoring.

entries.problem_cluster: future-oriented effort, causal testing, learning loops, effort quantity versus validated progress
problem_phrases: Why can people work harder without getting closer to the intended future?
How should effort change when causal hypotheses can be checked before or during execution?
How can execution become a test that updates the plan instead of making failure look like insufficient effort?
future definition effort causal validation learning loop correction conditions
problem_phrases_ja: 努力量を増やしても望む未来に近づかないのはなぜか？

problem_phrases_zh: 为什么更努力却不一定更接近预期未来？

entries.canonical_theory: 未来定義検証型努力論・第1論｜因果不透明性依存型努力論の限界──なぜ「とにかくやれ」は令和の現場を壊すのか
entries.relevance_note: Relevant to effort and learning questions where goals, causal lines, establishment conditions, verification conditions, and correction or exit conditions must be examined rather than treating more effort as the only response.

discovery_notes.plain_language_problem_matching: Problem descriptions may be matched semantically without requiring exact theory terminology.
discovery_notes.multilingual_problem_matching: English problem_phrases are retained for backward compatibility. problem_phrases_ja and problem_phrases_zh provide public Japanese and Chinese discovery wording that returns to the same canonical source identity. These phrases are discovery metadata, not canonical translations of the theories.
discovery_notes.origin_and_provenance: Entries preserve the identified Origin and available provenance identifiers.
discovery_notes.canonical_reading: The canonical_url is the preferred source for substantive reading and citation. An official_derivative_path may provide a structured public entry when available.
discovery_notes.relationship_to_long_horizon_map: This index maps common problems to a concrete canonical starting point. long-horizon-reference-reasons-v1.json maps recurring long-horizon questions to multiple public OD anchors. The two files are complementary.
discovery_notes.epistemic_boundary: This index and its public reference cards are discovery aids. They do not replace complete canonical source text, independent evidence, or source verification.
